subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Betray
solution:
The correct answer is **"Protect".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• '**Betray**' means to be disloyal or unfaithful, or to reveal information about someone or something in a way that is not loyal. (धोखा देना)

 
 
• **Example**- He would rather face punishment than betray his friends.
 
 
 
• '**Protect**' signifies guarding or safeguarding someone or something. (सुरक्षित करना) 
 
 
• **Example**- He promised to protect his friend's secrets.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is Opposite in meaning to 'Betray' is 'Protect'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Disloyal**' means lacking in loyalty, unfaithful or treacherous. (विश्वासघाती) 
 
• '**Sympathy**' means feelings of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune. (सहानुभूति) 
 
• '**Adverse**' means preventing success or development, harmful or unfavorable. (प्रतिकूल)
